This script analyzes RNAseq (transcriptomics) data. It's my first time doing this lol

----------------------------
HOW TO USE THIS SCRIPT
Always run Sections 1. Packages, 2. Functions, 3. Data
Sections 4. Differential Expression and 5. Functional Analyses should run independently of each other.

---------------------------

To write section 4 of this script, I heavily depended on AI. Section 5.1. is based off this v helpful github post:
https://aseetharam.github.io/bioinformatics/run-go-enrichment-maize/

The B73_GO.out data was downloaded from (you need to use the command line):
https://download.maizegdb.org/GeneFunction_and_Expression/Pannzer_GO_Terms/B73_GO.out

# 4. Differential Expression Analyses:
## 4.1. PCA

```{r}
pal <- c("#1F66A9", "#E08201", "#8dc5e4ff")


```


```{r}
rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta), drop = FALSE]

dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)
```

```{r}

for (seg in names(DE_results)) {

  meta_seg <- dat_meta[
    as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[
    ,
    rownames(meta_seg),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  dds_pca <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group + genotype:condition_group
  )

  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds_pca) >= 10) >= 2

  dds_pca <- dds_pca[keep, ]

  vsd <- DESeq2::vst(
    dds_pca,
    blind = TRUE
  )

  pca <- prcomp(
    t(SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd))
  )

  pca_data <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(pca$x),
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    genotype = meta_seg[rownames(pca$x), "genotype"],
    condition_group = meta_seg[rownames(pca$x), "condition_group"]
  )

  percent_var <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

  p <- ggplot(
    pca_data,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      fill = genotype,
      shape = condition_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4, color = "black",
               stroke = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "w" = 21,
      "c" = 23
    )
  ) +
    xlab(
      paste0(
        "PC1 (",
        round(percent_var[1], 1),
        "%)"
      )
    ) +
    ylab(
      paste0(
        "PC2 (",
        round(percent_var[2], 1),
        "%)"
      )
    ) +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(seg, " - PCA")
    ) +
    theme(text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color='black'),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black')) +
    theme_classic()
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("03_local_response_RNAseq/02_plots/PCA_", seg, ".svg"),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    units = "cm")
}
```

```{r}
    ,

  ]

    rownames(meta_seg),

  ]
  
  dds_pca <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group
  )
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds_pca) >= 10) >= 2
  dds_pca <- dds_pca[keep, ]
  
  dds_pca <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds_pca)
  
  vsd <- DESeq2::vst(
    dds_pca,
    blind = FALSE
  )
  
  pca_data <- DESeq2::plotPCA(
    vsd,
    intgroup = c("genotype", "condition_group"),
    returnData = TRUE
  )
  
  percent_var <- round(
    100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar")
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    pca_data,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = genotype,
      shape = condition_group,
      label = name
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percent_var[1], "%)")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percent_var[2], "%)")) +
    ggtitle(paste0("PCA - ", seg)) +
    theme_classic()
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
for (seg in c("S1", "S2", "S3")) {

  meta_seg <- dat_meta[as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg, , drop = FALSE]

  meta_seg <- meta_seg[
    rownames(meta_seg) %in% colnames(dat_raw_counts),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]

  meta_seg <- meta_seg[colnames(counts_seg), , drop = FALSE]

  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group
  )

  dds <- dds[rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2, ]

  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)

  vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

  pca <- prcomp(t(assay(vsd)))

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(pca$x),
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2]
  )

  pca_df$genotype <- meta_seg[pca_df$Sample, "genotype"]
  pca_df$condition_group <- meta_seg[pca_df$Sample, "condition_group"]

  var_explained <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

  ggplot(
    pca_df,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = genotype,
      shape = condition_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Sample),
      vjust = -1,
      size = 3
    ) +
    xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)")) +
    ggtitle(paste("PCA -", seg)) +
```

## 4.2. Volcano plots

```{r}
for (seg in names(DE_results)) {
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Select this segment AND wounded samples only
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  meta_seg <- dat_meta[
    as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg &
    as.character(dat_meta$condition_group) == "w",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[
    ,
    rownames(meta_seg),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2: genotype comparison within wounded samples
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds_W <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype
  )
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds_W) >= 10) >= 2
  dds_W <- dds_W[keep, ]
  
  dds_W <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds_W)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutant vs WT in wounded samples
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds_W,
    contrast = c("genotype", "lox", "kn")
  )
  
  res_haci_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds_W,
    contrast = c("genotype", "haci", "kn")
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep ONLY genes that are WT wounded DEGs
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  WT_wounded_genes <- rownames(
    DE_results[[seg]]$WT_wounded
  )
  
  res_lox_W <- res_lox_W[
    rownames(res_lox_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  res_haci_W <- res_haci_W[
    rownames(res_haci_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}
```

```{r}
for (seg in names(DE_results)) {
```
  
```{r}
  # =======================================================
  # WOUNDED SAMPLES ONLY
  # =======================================================
  
  meta_seg <- dat_meta[
    as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg &
      as.character(dat_meta$condition_group) == "w",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[
    ,
    rownames(meta_seg),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  dds_W <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype
  )
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds_W) >= 10) >= 2
  dds_W <- dds_W[keep, ]
  
  dds_W <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds_W)
  
  
  # =======================================================
  # WT WOUNDED DEGs
  # =======================================================
  
  # This defines the WT wounded DEG set:
  # WT wounded vs WT control
  #
  # NOTE:
  # This requires the WT wounded DEG list to already exist.
  # If your WT wounded DEG object has a different name,
  # replace WT_wounded_genes below.
  
  WT_wounded_genes <- DE_results[[seg]]$WT_wounded_genes
  
  
  # =======================================================
  # MUTANT vs WT IN WOUNDED SAMPLES
  # =======================================================
  
  res_lox_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds_W,
    contrast = c(
      "genotype",
      "lox",
      "kn"
    )
  )
  
  res_haci_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds_W,
    contrast = c(
      "genotype",
      "haci",
      "kn"
    )
  )
  
  
  # Keep ONLY genes that are WT wounded DEGs
  
  res_lox_W <- res_lox_W[
    rownames(res_lox_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  res_haci_W <- res_haci_W[
    rownames(res_haci_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  
  # =======================================================
  # LOX10 VOLCANO
  # =======================================================
  
  volcano_data <- as.data.frame(res_lox_W) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj),
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj < 0.05 &
          log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up",
        
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj < 0.05 &
          log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Down",
        
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  n_up <- sum(
    volcano_data$significance == "Up",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_down <- sum(
    volcano_data$significance == "Down",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  p_lox <- ggplot(
    volcano_data,
    aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = neg_log10_padj
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = significance),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up" = "red",
        "Down" = "blue",
        "NS" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Up: ", n_up,
        "\nDown: ", n_down
      ),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.2,
      size = 4
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        seg,
        " - lox10 W vs WT W\nWT wounded DEG subset"
      ),
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      color = NULL
    )
  
  print(p_lox)
  
  
  # =======================================================
  # HACI VOLCANO
  # =======================================================
  
  volcano_data <- as.data.frame(res_haci_W) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj),
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj < 0.05 &
          log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up",
        
        !is.na(padj) &
          padj < 0.05 &
          log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Down",
        
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  n_up <- sum(
    volcano_data$significance == "Up",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_down <- sum(
    volcano_data$significance == "Down",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  p_haci <- ggplot(
    volcano_data,
    aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = neg_log10_padj
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = significance),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up" = "red",
        "Down" = "blue",
        "NS" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Up: ", n_up,
        "\nDown: ", n_down
      ),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.2,
      size = 4
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        seg,
        " - haci W vs WT W\nWT wounded DEG subset"
      ),
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      color = NULL
    )
  
  print(p_haci)
}
```

```{r}
for (seg in names(DE_results)) {
  
  meta_seg <- dat_meta[
    as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[
    ,
    rownames(meta_seg),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group + genotype:condition_group
  )
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # WT wounded vs WT control
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_WT_wounding <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    contrast = c(
      "condition_group",
      "w",
      "c"
    )
  )
  
  # WT wounded DEG subset
  WT_wounded_genes <- rownames(res_WT_wounding)[
    !is.na(res_WT_wounding$padj) &
    res_WT_wounding$padj < 0.05
  ]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # lox10 wounded vs WT wounded
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    contrast = list(
      c(
        "genotypelox",
        "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
      )
    )
  )
  
  res_lox_W <- res_lox_W[
    rownames(res_lox_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # haci wounded vs WT wounded
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_haci_W <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    contrast = list(
      c(
        "genotypehaci",
        "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
      )
    )
  )
  
  res_haci_W <- res_haci_W[
    rownames(res_haci_W) %in% WT_wounded_genes,
    ]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Counts
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  n_lox <- sum(
    !is.na(res_lox_W$padj) &
    res_lox_W$padj < 0.05
  )
  
  n_haci <- sum(
    !is.na(res_haci_W$padj) &
    res_haci_W$padj < 0.05
  )
  
  print(
    paste0(
      seg,
      " - WT wounded DEG subset: ",
      length(WT_wounded_genes),
      " genes"
    )
  )
  
  print(
    paste0(
      seg,
      " - lox10 W vs WT W: ",
      n_lox,
      " significant genes"
    )
  )
  
  print(
    paste0(
      seg,
      " - haci W vs WT W: ",
      n_haci,
      " significant genes"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================

#                         response in mutant than WT
#
#   log2FoldChange < 0 = weaker/more negative C vs W

# =========================================================

for (seg in names(DE_results)) {

  res <- DE_results[[seg]]$lox10_vs_WT
  
  volcano_data <- res %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj),
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Up",
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
```

## 4.1. Heatmap
### 4.1.1 DESeq2 for heatmap

```{r}

# 1. Create DESeq2 object (Replace with your actual data frames)
# countData: matrix of raw gene counts
# colData: dataframe with sample metadata, last condition is the default comparison (so it's treat vs. ctrl)

# make subset:

# dat_subset_ph <- dat_raw_counts[
#   match(dat_ph_goi$Gene_ID_v5, rownames(dat_raw_counts)),
#   ,
#   drop = FALSE
# ]
# 
# dat_subset_ph <- dat_subset_ph[!is.na(dat_subset_ph$kn_c1_S1), , drop = FALSE]

dat_subset_ph <- dat_raw_counts[
  match(dat_goi$Gene_ID, rownames(dat_raw_counts)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dat_subset_ph <- dat_subset_ph[!is.na(dat_subset_ph$kn_c1_S1), , drop = FALSE]

genotypes <- unique(dat_meta$genotype)
segments <- unique(dat_meta$segment)

results_list <- list()
dds_list <- list()

for(g in genotypes){
  for(s in segments){

    keep <- dat_meta$genotype == g &
            dat_meta$segment == s

    dds_sub <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = dat_subset_ph[, keep],
      colData = dat_meta[keep, ],
      design = ~ condition_group
    )

    dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

    res <- results(dds_sub,
                   contrast = c("condition_group", "w", "c"))

    results_list[[paste(g, s, sep = "_")]] <- res
    dds_list[[paste(g, s, sep = "_")]] <- dds_sub
  }
}

```

```{r}
# create matrix for heatmap

for (name in c(
  "kn_S1", "kn_S2", "kn_S3",
  "lox_S1", "lox_S2", "lox_S3",
  "haci_S1", "haci_S2", "haci_S3"
)) {

  # DESeq2 results
  res <- as.data.frame(results_list[[name]])

  # VST transform
  vst_data <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(
    dds_list[[name]],
    blind = FALSE
  )

  vst_matrix <- assay(vst_data)

  # scale each gene
  heatmap_matrix <- t(scale(t(vst_matrix)))

  # get treatment labels
  condition <- colData(dds_list[[name]])$condition_group

  # average replicates
  heatmap_avg <- sapply(
    levels(condition),
    function(x) {
      rowMeans(heatmap_matrix[, condition == x, drop = FALSE])
    }
  )

  # reorder rows according to dat_phytohormone_goi order
  row_order <- match(dat_phytohormone_goi$Gene_ID_v5, rownames(heatmap_avg))
  row_order <- row_order[!is.na(row_order)]

  heatmap_avg <- heatmap_avg[row_order, ]

  # replace row names with gene names
  gene_names <- dat_phytohormone_goi$gene_name[
    match(rownames(heatmap_avg), dat_phytohormone_goi$Gene_ID_v5)
  ]

  rownames(heatmap_avg) <- gene_names
  colnames(heatmap_avg) <- c("Control", "MW")


  ## star matrix for this name only
  
  star_matrix <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = nrow(heatmap_avg),
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(
      rownames(heatmap_avg),
      name
    )
  )

  res <- results_list[[name]]

  common <- intersect(rownames(res), rownames(star_matrix))

  padj <- res[common, "padj"]

  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.001], name] <- "***"
  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.01 & padj >= 0.001], name] <- "**"
  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & padj >= 0.01], name] <- "*"


  # make stars match heatmap dimensions
  stars <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = nrow(heatmap_avg),
    ncol = ncol(heatmap_avg),
    dimnames = dimnames(heatmap_avg)
  )

  stars[, "MW"] <- star_matrix[, name]


  ## save heatmap
  
  # pdf(paste0(name, "_hm2.pdf"), width = 5, height = 12)

  pheatmap(
    heatmap_avg,
    display_numbers = stars,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    fontsize_row = 10,
    cellwidth = 10,
    cellheight = 10,
    main = name
  )

  # dev.off()
}
```

## 4.2. Barplots log-fold change

### 4.2.1. Subset of genes

Loop for everything from ChatGPT:

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

# Make sure count matrix follows metadata order
dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta)]

# Factors
dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Function
# ---------------------------------------------------------

make_segment_plot <- function(segment_name,
                              counts,
                              metadata,
                              goi,
                              padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Subset metadata and counts for this segment
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  meta_seg <- metadata %>%
    filter(segment == segment_name)
  
  counts_seg <- counts[, rownames(meta_seg)]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Create DESeq2 object
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group +
              genotype:condition_group
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Filter low-count genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Run DESeq2
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Interaction tests
  #
  # Does the C-vs-W response differ between:
  #   WT vs lox
  #   WT vs haci
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_interaction <- results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  res_haci_interaction <- results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Significant interaction genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_lox <- rownames(res_lox_interaction)[
    !is.na(res_lox_interaction$padj) &
      res_lox_interaction$padj < padj_cutoff
  ]
  
  sig_haci <- rownames(res_haci_interaction)[
    !is.na(res_haci_interaction$padj) &
      res_haci_interaction$padj < padj_cutoff
  ]
  
  
  # Significant in WT-vs-lox OR WT-vs-haci
  sig_genes <- union(
    sig_lox,
    sig_haci
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Restrict to genes of interest
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_genes <- intersect(
    sig_genes,
    goi$Gene_ID
  )
  
  
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Get C vs W effects
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c(
    "condition_group",
    "c",
    "w"
  )
)

res_lox <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)

res_haci <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Convert C vs W → W vs C
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT$log2FoldChange <- -res_WT$log2FoldChange
res_lox$log2FoldChange <- -res_lox$log2FoldChange
res_haci$log2FoldChange <- -res_haci$log2FoldChange
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. Create plotting dataframe
  #
  # Keep both log2FC and lfcSE
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "WT",
      log2FC = res_WT[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_WT[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "lox",
      log2FC = res_lox[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_lox[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "haci",
      log2FC = res_haci[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_haci[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    )
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------- 
  # 12. Add interaction p-values to plotting data
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    padj_lox_vs_WT = res_lox_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"],
    padj_haci_vs_WT = res_haci_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"]
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Create a significance label:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Calculate vjust in data:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    star_y = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE,
      log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE
    ),
    star_vjust = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      -0.3,
      1.3
    )
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. Add gene names
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      goi %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene_ID, gene_name),
      by = "Gene_ID"
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. Plot
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = gene_name,
      y = log2FC,
      fill = genotype
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE,
        ymax = log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.25
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = significance,
        y = star_y,
        vjust = star_vjust
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    labs(
      title = segment_name,
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2 fold change (C vs W)",
      fill = "Genotype"
    ) +
    
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. Return everything
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  return(
    list(
      dds = dds,
      significant_genes = sig_genes,
      interaction_lox = res_lox_interaction,
      interaction_haci = res_haci_interaction,
      plot_data = plot_data,
      plot = p
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------

make_segment_plot <- function(segment_name,

  # -------------------------------------------------------

  # sig_haci <- rownames(res_haci_interaction)[
  #   !is.na(res_haci_interaction$padj) &
  #     res_haci_interaction$padj < padj_cutoff
  # ]
  
  
  # Significant in WT-vs-lox OR WT-vs-haci
  # sig_genes <- union(
  #   sig_lox,
  #   sig_haci
  # )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Restrict to genes of interest
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  # sig_genes <- intersect(
  #   sig_genes,
  #   goi$Gene_ID
  # )
 
  # Just use the predefined genes instead:
  sig_genes <- goi$Gene_ID 
  
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Get C vs W effects
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c(
    "condition_group",
    "c",
    "w"
  )
)

res_lox <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)

res_haci <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Convert C vs W → W vs C
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT$log2FoldChange <- -res_WT$log2FoldChange
res_lox$log2FoldChange <- -res_lox$log2FoldChange
res_haci$log2FoldChange <- -res_haci$log2FoldChange
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. Create plotting dataframe
  #
  # Keep both log2FC and lfcSE
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "WT",
      log2FC = res_WT[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_WT[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "lox",
      log2FC = res_lox[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_lox[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "haci",
      log2FC = res_haci[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_haci[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    )
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------- 
  # 12. Add interaction p-values to plotting data
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    padj_lox_vs_WT = res_lox_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"],
    padj_haci_vs_WT = res_haci_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"]
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Create a significance label:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Calculate vjust in data:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    star_y = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE,
      log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE
    ),
    star_vjust = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      -0.3,
      1.3
    )
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. Add gene names
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      goi %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene_ID, gene_name),
      by = "Gene_ID"
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. Plot
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = gene_name,
      y = log2FC,
      fill = genotype
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE,
        ymax = log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.25
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = significance,
        y = star_y,
        vjust = star_vjust
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    labs(
      title = segment_name,
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2 fold change (C vs W)",
      fill = "Genotype"
    ) +
    
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. Return everything
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  return(
    list(
      dds = dds,
      significant_genes = sig_genes,
      interaction_lox = res_lox_interaction,
      interaction_haci = res_haci_interaction,
      plot_data = plot_data,
      plot = p
    )
  )
}
```


# 5. Functional interpretation

Make lists of genes for GO-Term analyses

```{r}
# library(dplyr)
# library(tibble)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta), drop = FALSE]

dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Function
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_segment_interaction <- function(
    segment_name,
    counts,
    metadata,
    padj_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  
  # Subset metadata
  meta_seg <- metadata[
    as.character(metadata$segment) == segment_name,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Keep only samples present in counts
  meta_seg <- meta_seg[
    rownames(meta_seg) %in% colnames(counts),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Subset counts
  counts_seg <- counts[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure identical sample order
  counts_seg <- counts_seg[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]
  
  # Drop unused factor levels
  meta_seg$genotype <- droplevels(meta_seg$genotype)
  meta_seg$condition_group <- droplevels(meta_seg$condition_group)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 object
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group +
      genotype:condition_group
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Filter low-count genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Run DESeq2
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # lox10 vs WT interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # haci vs WT interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_haci <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert to data frames
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_df <- as.data.frame(res_lox)
  res_lox_df$Gene_ID <- rownames(res_lox_df)
  rownames(res_lox_df) <- NULL
  
  res_lox_df$segment <- segment_name
  res_lox_df$comparison <- "lox10_vs_WT"
  
  res_haci_df <- as.data.frame(res_haci)
  res_haci_df$Gene_ID <- rownames(res_haci_df)
  rownames(res_haci_df) <- NULL
  
  res_haci_df$segment <- segment_name
  res_haci_df$comparison <- "haci_vs_WT"
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_lox <- res_lox_df[
    !is.na(res_lox_df$padj) &
      res_lox_df$padj < padj_cutoff,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  sig_haci <- res_haci_df[
    !is.na(res_haci_df$padj) &
      res_haci_df$padj < padj_cutoff,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Positive interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  lox10_positive <- sig_lox$Gene_ID[
    sig_lox$log2FoldChange > 0
  ]
  
  haci_positive <- sig_haci$Gene_ID[
    sig_haci$log2FoldChange > 0
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Negative interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  lox10_negative <- sig_lox$Gene_ID[
    sig_lox$log2FoldChange < 0
  ]
  
  haci_negative <- sig_haci$Gene_ID[
    sig_haci$log2FoldChange < 0
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Either mutant
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  either_mutant <- union(
    sig_lox$Gene_ID,
    sig_haci$Gene_ID
  )
  
  either_mutant_positive <- union(
    lox10_positive,
    haci_positive
  )
  
  either_mutant_negative <- union(
    lox10_negative,
    haci_negative
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Return
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  list(
    dds = dds,
    
    lox10_vs_WT = res_lox_df,
    haci_vs_WT = res_haci_df,
    
    significant_lox10_vs_WT = sig_lox,
    significant_haci_vs_WT = sig_haci,
    
    lox10_positive = lox10_positive,
    lox10_negative = lox10_negative,
    
    haci_positive = haci_positive,
    haci_negative = haci_negative,
    
    either_mutant = either_mutant,
    either_mutant_positive = either_mutant_positive,
    either_mutant_negative = either_mutant_negative
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Run all segments
# ---------------------------------------------------------

segments <- unique(as.character(dat_meta$segment))

DE_results <- lapply(
  segments,
  function(seg) {
    
    message("Running segment: ", seg)
    
    run_segment_interaction(
      segment_name = seg,
      counts = dat_raw_counts,
      metadata = dat_meta,
      padj_cutoff = 0.05
    )
  }
)

names(DE_results) <- segments


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Gene vectors for topGO
# ---------------------------------------------------------

topGO_genes <- lapply(
  DE_results,
  function(x) {
    
    list(
      lox10_positive = x$lox10_positive,
      lox10_negative = x$lox10_negative,
      
      haci_positive = x$haci_positive,
      haci_negative = x$haci_negative,
      
      either_mutant = x$either_mutant,
      either_mutant_positive = x$either_mutant_positive,
      either_mutant_negative = x$either_mutant_negative
    )
  }
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Individual vectors
# ---------------------------------------------------------

S1_lox10_positive <- topGO_genes$S1$lox10_positive
S1_lox10_negative <- topGO_genes$S1$lox10_negative
S1_haci_positive <- topGO_genes$S1$haci_positive
S1_haci_negative <- topGO_genes$S1$haci_negative

S2_lox10_negative <- topGO_genes$S2$lox10_negative
S2_haci_positive <- topGO_genes$S2$haci_positive
S2_haci_negative <- topGO_genes$S2$haci_negative

S3_lox10_positive <- topGO_genes$S3$lox10_positive
S3_lox10_negative <- topGO_genes$S3$lox10_negative
S3_haci_positive <- topGO_genes$S3$haci_positive
S3_haci_negative <- topGO_genes$S3$haci_negative

sapply(

  function(x) sapply(x, length)
```

```{r}
# format go-term df:
dat_b73_go1 <- dat_b73_go[(dat_b73_go$ARGOT_PPV > 0.5), ]  # filter to only include genes that have confident ARGOT_score assigned to them
```

```{r}
# Function that does it for all:
make_topGO_gene_vector <- function(selected_genes, background_genes) {

  # Remove genes that aren't in the GO annotation background
  selected_genes <- intersect(
    selected_genes,
    background_genes
  )

  # Create yes/no vector
  myGenesF <- factor(
    as.integer(background_genes %in% selected_genes)
  )

  names(myGenesF) <- background_genes

  return(myGenesF)
}

myGenesF <- make_topGO_gene_vector(
  topGO_genes$S2$haci_positive,
  gene_names
)
```

Run enrichment analysis:
```{r}
# run_topGO <- function(gene_list, ontology, gene2GO_list){
#   topGO_data <- new("topGOdata", ontology = ontology, allGenes = gene_list,
#                     annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = gene2GO_list)
#   fishers_result <- runTest(topGO_data, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "fisher")
#   fishers_table <- GenTable(topGO_data, Fishers = fishers_result, useLevels = TRUE)
#   fishers_table$Ontology <- ontology
#   fishers_table
# }

# Add FDR

run_topGO <- function(gene_list, ontology, gene2GO_list) {

  topGO_data <- new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = ontology,
    allGenes = gene_list,
    annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
    gene2GO = gene2GO_list
  )

  fishers_result <- runTest(
    topGO_data,
    algorithm = "elim",
    statistic = "fisher"
  )

  fishers_table <- GenTable(
    topGO_data,
    Fishers = fishers_result,
    useLevels = TRUE
  )

  fishers_table$Ontology <- ontology

  # Convert p-value to numeric
  fishers_table$Fishers <- as.numeric(
    fishers_table$Fishers
  )

  # Multiple-testing correction
  fishers_table$FDR <- p.adjust(
    fishers_table$Fishers,
    method = "BH"
  )

  fishers_table
}
```

```{r}
# one big loop:

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")

gene_sets <- c(
  "lox10_positive",
  "lox10_negative",
  "haci_positive",
  "haci_negative",
  "either_mutant_positive",
  "either_mutant_negative"
)

ontologies <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTION TO RUN ONE ANALYSIS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_one_GO_analysis <- function(segment, gene_set) {

  message(
    "Running: ",
    segment,
    " | ",
    gene_set
  )

  # Genes of interest
  selected_genes <- topGO_genes[[segment]][[gene_set]]

  # Create TopGO input vector
  myGenesF <- make_topGO_gene_vector(
    selected_genes,
    gene_names
  )

  # Run BP
  BP <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "BP",
    all_golist
  )

  # Run MF
  MF <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "MF",
    all_golist
  )

  # Run CC
  CC <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "CC",
    all_golist
  )

  # Combine
  combined <- rbind(BP, MF, CC)

  # Add metadata
  combined$Segment <- segment
  combined$GeneSet <- gene_set

  # Order by raw p-value
  combined <- combined[
    order(combined$Fishers),
  ]

  return(combined)
}
```

```{r}
# run everything:

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# RUN ALL ANALYSES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

GO_results <- list()

for (segment in segments) {

  for (gene_set in gene_sets) {

    result_name <- paste(
      segment,
      gene_set,
      sep = "_"
    )

    GO_results[[result_name]] <- run_one_GO_analysis(
      segment,
      gene_set
    )
  }
}
```

## 5.2. KEGG
